capture.entrypoint: actual pinned Vite apps/web/index.html and App.svelte; real localhost HTTP documents; no Playwright route interception or fulfill
capture.backForwardCache: enabled by omitting Chromium's --disable-back-forward-cache default argument

cases.description: Open Settings from the real App sidebar, edit a setting, show Memory, scroll, start a Forget confirmation, navigate by GET form to a same-origin raw HTML document, then Back.

Submit a same-origin GET form to a held HTTP response, then use CDP pointer input at real Settings and Memory tab hit targets measured before navigation. A document click observer reports the live dialog/tab state to the local server before releasing the response; capture the raw document and Back restoration. If Chrome blocks those clicks, record the reason and use the marked direct-navigation fallback.
Open actual App pages through _blank and named HTML form targets, open different Settings tabs in each, then switch between pages and record each dialog/tab state.
